workflow: Each template receives one independently generated parent composition and three separately generated candidates that use the saved parent PNG as their visual reference. Cheaper is a commercial goal, not a proven cost claim, because this provider did not report per-image cost.

templates.parent_prompt: Premium editorial website hero for a fictional Black-owned Port St. Lucie barbershop: Black barber performing a precision fade, blackened steel, warm parchment, walnut, restrained oxblood, electric coral and tiny cobalt details, coastal daylight, subject right, negative space left, no text or UI.
candidate_prompts: Same visual canon; opening-time environment with barber checking the day's bookings beside empty oxblood chairs.
Same visual canon; close process frame of gloved hands, clippers, comb, and precise fade calibration.
Same visual canon; finished client profile with immaculate fade and beard line, barber reflected behind.

templates.parent_prompt: Premium editorial website hero for a fictional Black woman-owned Fort Pierce texture-care studio: stylist mapping and shaping a client's healthy natural coils, warm cream, cocoa, clay plaster, raw linen, deep plum, rose-copper and subtle violet, botanical shadow, negative space right, no text or UI.
candidate_prompts: Same visual canon; consultation environment with stylist and client reviewing a simple care plan at a curved clay table.
Same visual canon; process/detail frame of gentle coil separation and healthy texture assessment.
Same visual canon; finished-care portrait with client viewing the shaped coil result in a rounded mirror.

templates.parent_prompt: Premium campaign photograph for a fictional bilingual Latino-owned West Palm Beach barbería: barber finishing a taper, authentic multigenerational neighborhood energy, cream tile, navy, coral, sea teal, yellow registration accent, chrome and terrazzo, subject left, no text or UI.
candidate_prompts: Same visual canon; morning environment with barber checking appointments and two generations arriving.
Same visual canon; close process view of taper detailing with comb, clippers, coral arch and teal tile behind.
Same visual canon; satisfied client checks the finished taper while barber and waiting customers share a relaxed moment.

templates.parent_prompt: Premium editorial website hero for a fictional woman-owned Miami color studio: white female colorist and client comparing translucent color swatches, pearl plaster, sea-glass aqua, oxblood, soft mint, coral, brushed gold and prismatic daylight, negative space left, no text or UI.
candidate_prompts: Same visual canon; consultation environment with colorist and client reviewing hair history and physical swatches.
Same visual canon; close process frame of dimensional color painting with foils and brush.
Same visual canon; finished transformation and maintenance frame with client at a curved mirror and a take-home trio.
